name: slip
title: SLIP
summary: Interactive 3D segmentation of any structure from a few clicks.
description: Click inside a structure to segment it in 3D; click outside to remove what does not belong. An image larger than 512 voxels on a side is worked on at a reduced resolution.
author: IRCAD (Podvin et al.)

purpose.detail: Any structure in CT or MR, refined click by click.

legal.intendedUse: Research on interactive segmentation. Research use only, not a medical device.
legal.limitations: Point prompts only. One user at a time: the model holds one image.
